text:
Cole Knuble is the son of longtime NHL forward Mike Knuble, a fourth-round pick out of Notre Dame, and nine games into his NHL career he's one of the more interesting young Flyers. He has three goals, all of his points, and The Hockey News and Yahoo Sports have called him a quick key for a young team. The Flyers even tried him at center against the Rangers, with the Inquirer quoting the reason: "We need some speed up the middle."

He has that speed: faster than 93% of the league by NHL Edge. And his shots have been dangerous for a fourth-liner, which is why he's one of our Sleepers tonight in Vancouver at 15% to score. Philadelphia is about seven points of expected goal share better with him on the ice than off it.

The usual rookie caveats apply. Nine games is nothing, his 18.8% shooting is high, and Charlie O'Connor noted a failed clear at the point that cost a goal. Our range is wide, 11 to 24 goals over a full season. On a team that badly needs young players to step up, he has taken his first steps.
headline: Knuble brings speed to a slow team
